content.title: Build the Document Skeleton
content.hook: A full HTML document has a basic outer structure.
content.context:
```html Forge

Forge

Build frontend engineering skill.

``` For now, learn the jobs of these pieces: - `` tells the browser to use the modern HTML document mode. - `` wraps the document. - `` contains document information that is not the main page content. - `` gives the document a title. - `<body>` contains the content the page presents.
goals: Recognize the basic HTML document structure and place page content in the correct part of the document.

options.text: `<head>` contains the visible page content and `<body>` contains `<html>`

feedback.correct: The document is nested: `<html>` is the outer element, with `<head>` and `<body>` inside it.
feedback.incorrect: The document is nested: `<html>` is the outer element, with `<head>` and `<body>` inside it.

content.question: You need to add the visible heading “Forge Academy.” Where does it belong?

feedback.correct: The page content the user sees belongs in the document body.
feedback.incorrect: The page content the user sees belongs in the document body.

content.question: Which item belongs in the `<head>` in this lesson’s simple model?

feedback.correct: The title is document information. The visible page content belongs in the body.
feedback.incorrect: The title is document information. The visible page content belongs in the body.

content.question:
A learner writes: ```html

Forge

Forge ``` What is the problem in the model being practiced here?

options.text: The `<head>` and `<body>` are supposed to be sibling parts of the HTML document, with the head placed before the body.

feedback.correct: The basic document skeleton is `<html>` containing `<head>` followed by `<body>`.
feedback.incorrect: The basic document skeleton is `<html>` containing `<head>` followed by `<body>`.

content.question:
Complete the sentence:

“The `<head>` describes document information; the `<body>` contains ________.”

feedback.correct: For this lesson, keep the model simple: head = document information, body = page content.
feedback.incorrect: For this lesson, keep the model simple: head = document information, body = page content.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** A full HTML page has a predictable outer structure.
**Senior habit:** When a document feels messy, first inspect its outer structure. Good nesting makes the rest easier to reason about.
nextSteps: Complete the lesson activities and demonstrate the target skill without relying on unseen concepts from later modules.
